hooks.name: Post-step verification reminder
hooks.description: After any step script finishes, reminds to verify outputs against quality gate checklist before proceeding to next step.

action.prompt:
A step script just ran. Before declaring success, verify:
1. No duplicate node/edge IDs in output
2. No dangling edges (referencing non-existent nodes)
3. Manifest is updated with correct artifact hash and row counts
4. No test-period data leaked into train artifacts
5. content_hash or relevant checksums are deterministic (re-run produces same output)
Report which checks passed and which could not be verified.
